inputs.name: timezone
inputs.description: IANA time zone, such as Europe/Dublin.

inputs.name: chrony_set_clock
inputs.description: Let chronyd set the system clock. Set to false in containers, and on VMs whose hypervisor sets the clock, so chronyd runs with -x.

inputs.name: sysctl
inputs.description: Kernel parameters to set, by name.

inputs.name: sshd_settings
inputs.description: sshd settings to write to /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/00-conn3x-baseline.conf, by keyword.
